observation: After the top-level summary truncation marker was closed, fresh main still silently bounded the repository extension histogram to 16 rows. With 17 observed extensions, repositorySummary.extensions returned only 16 with no field-specific marker, so the cognition summary could not distinguish a complete histogram from an incomplete bounded view.

decision_provenance.route_basis: The newly exposed adjacent observation-integrity defect is singular, directly falsifiable, and requires only making an existing bounded summary honest about its own loss. The four-mode contract therefore resolves to DEEP_DEVELOPMENT without forced mode rotation.

pre_fix_reproduction: A synthetic manifest containing 17 distinct extensions produced extensions.length=16 while extensionsTruncated was absent. The new regression failed with undefined != true.
change: Compute the already-existing sorted extension rows once, preserve the 16-row bounded histogram exactly, and expose extensionsTruncated when observed extension categories exceed that view.

validation.pre_fix_reproduction: EXPECTED FAILURE reproduced: incomplete 16-of-17 extension view had no truncation marker

truth_boundary: This only marks truncation of the observed extension histogram. It does not expand manifest coverage, infer extensions outside an already-truncated manifest, alter extension ranking policy, solve large-repository context selection, or solve arbitrary complex repository synthesis.
